name: Barack Obama
birthplace: Kapiolani Medical Center for Women and Children
summary: Barack Hussein Obama II (born August 4, 1961) is an American retired politician who was the 44th president of the United States from 2009 to 2017. A member of the Democratic Party, he was the first African American  to serve as president. Obama represented Illinois in the United States Senate from 2005 to 2008 and served as an Illinois state senator from 1997 to 2004.
